dedupe_keys.name: crop type reference polygons for consistent land cover classification in central asia cawa project

description: This dataset offers thousands of crop type field polygons collected in the Aral Sea Basin, described by its authors as the first extensive open dataset of crop samples in this data-scarce region. The figshare record says samples were collected with GPS in the Central Asia Waters (CAWa) project, turned into field polygons with high-resolution imagery, and checked with remote sensing and local expert knowledge of crop phenology, to support multi-temporal agricultural mapping. It was published in 2020 by Ruben Remelgado, Sherzod Zaitov, Shavkat Kenjabaev, Galina Stulina, Murod Sultanov, Mirzakhayot Ibrakhimov, Mustakim Akhmedov, Victor Dukhovny and Christopher Conrad, with version 3 and about 7.5 MB of files, downloadable and free under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is the Aral Sea Basin in Central Asia; the countries, years and crop list are not stated on the page read. Caveats: samples cover irrigated districts where field work was done, not the whole basin. For simulation it provides labels to map irrigated crops that depend on canal water, for irrigation shortage and drought scenarios. Related catalogue records include the WRI agricultural exposure to water stress data and the ACIA500 cropping intensity data.
